description: S459 LOW-4 + MED-1, restated for copy-in (S459 "a, go"): a write into a refined collection is judged by what it writes, against the position it writes. (1) `@x = @y` stores x's OWN copy; `@y.push(3)` is refused by @y's type (`number(>5)[]`) and @y is left unchanged. (2) `@x.push(-5)` is refused by @x's type. (3) a field write `@rows[1].n = -5` and (4) a row write `@rows[0] = { …, n: -5 }` are judged at the path. (5) `@p.b = @p.a` stores a copy at b; a push into b that b's type refuses is refused. (6) a push into a nested array `@mm[1].push(-5)`. Every refused write throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT and every cell keeps its prior value.
rationale: §53.3.3: "the compiler-generated check SHALL throw a runtime error with code E-CONTRACT-001-RT before the assignment is applied. The variable retains its prior value." §53.1: the check is "an O(1) boolean expression" over the incoming value — the element or field written, not the whole collection.
